## How to make sure you hire someone reliable

Before booking, ask these three questions\:

- “Are you licensed and insured for this type of work?”
- “What is your service-call or diagnostic fee, and will you provide a written estimate before repairs?”
- “Will you handle any required permits and inspections?”

You can independently verify electrical contractor licenses through the [North Carolina State Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors](https://www.ncbeec.org/)\.
